capabilities.title: Search Gmail
capabilities.description: Search Gmail through the read-only email gateway with bounded keyword, sender, date, and label filters. Returns opaque message handles.

capabilities.title: Read selected Gmail messages
capabilities.description: Retrieve sanitized plain-text content only for opaque handles returned by a recent Gmail search receipt.

capabilities.title: Analyze Gmail intake
capabilities.description: Analyze a receipt-bound, sanitized Gmail result and propose typed dashboard actions. It cannot access or mutate Gmail.

capabilities.title: Parse reservation
capabilities.description: Parse one receipt-bound, sanitized message into a proposed normalized travel reservation without Gmail access or mutation.
